verdict.rationale: Alloy is a SaaS identity, fraud and compliance platform that holds customer entity and evaluation data, so a bulk data-export axis applies. The pack documents no export or offboarding capability and no open-format bulk download. The REST API, webhooks and OpenAPI spec are developer building blocks for an integration, not a documented export-and-leave feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
